subject: D-INTEG-01 FEM physical media contract
body:
TASK: D-INTEG-01 FEM physical media
STATUS: CANDIDATE
FEM_STORAGE: canonical T2 DDR via MIG; T1 BRAM is hot cache only; C 32-bit sync T2 is local model not persistence
WRITE_ATOMICITY: logical FEM word 32b; physical beat APP_W UNKNOWN (candidate pack 128b=4 words); torn yes; reset can interrupt outstanding
COMPLETION_AUTHORITY: dest readback + matching txn_id/generation; wr_outstanding after matching rsp; FIFO-empty is NOT complete
INTEGRITY_SCHEME: CRC16-CCITT-FALSE W0||W1 generated before dest CRCW write; recovery always dest-rereads COMMIT+CRCW+W0+W1; no ECC in this candidate
COMMITTED_CORRUPT: COMMIT magic && CRC fail -> recover_state=3; do not COMMITTED_NEW; do not roll forward index/retire
RESET: outstanding writes are not drained; dest may be old/new/mixed
NEED_FROM_C: fem_lifecycle t2_we has no t2_ready/complete; cannot bind real MIG until FSM stalls per dest completion
FILES: rtl/native_ai/memory/FEM_MEDIA_CONTRACT.md fem_media_bridge.v fem_commit_class.v
TEST: python tb/learning/run_fem_media.py -> FEM_MEDIA_XSIM_PASS
NOT_CLAIMED: FEM_PERSIST_PASS BOARD_PASS
PROGRAM=NO XSim!=board
